description: React component for displaying and managing individual post edit history items, including restore and undo functionalities.

methods.name: handleUndo
methods.description: Fetches previous post version from edit history and restores it.

methods.name: showInfoTooltip
methods.description: Displays a tooltip indicating the message has been restored.

methods.name: handleRestore
methods.description: Restores the post to a selected version and clears related drafts.

methods.name: postHeader
methods.description: Memoized JSX for the post header including user avatar and profile.

methods.name: openRestorePostModal
methods.description: Opens modal to confirm post restoration.

methods.name: togglePost
methods.description: Toggles the visibility of the post's edit history content.
